if: the document is a bill of supply referred to in clause (c) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 49 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the bill of supply MUST carry a consecutive serial number of at most sixteen characters, unique for the financial year
note: One mandatory particular of rule 49(b), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: a consecutive serial number not exceeding sixteen characters, in one or multiple series, containing alphabets or numerals or special characters -hyphen or dash and slash symbolised as
evidence.extraction_note: The clause continues '―-‖ and ―/‖ respectively'; the PDF extraction renders the quotation marks as U+2015 and U+2016, so the quote stops before them and the tail is quoted separately. The artifact is in the extraction, not in the Rules.

evidence.quote: respectively, and any combination thereof, unique for a financial year;
